description: Defines an internal record class 'AdoNetStreamMessageAck' used for representing acknowledgements from the storage about message enqueuing, including identifiers such as service, provider, queue, and message ID.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamMessageAck
classes.description: An internal record representing an acknowledgement message from storage indicating that a message was enqueued, with identifiers for service, provider, queue, and message.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamMessageAck()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the acknowledgment with empty identifiers and zero message ID.
